statements.status_notes: react 16.0.0 is bundled as a static JS asset inside nbclassic 1.3.3, the latest release of the classic Jupyter Notebook UI extension shipped by zero-to-jupyterhub-k8s 4.4.1. CVE-2018-6341 describes a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in React prior to 16.4.2 where a malicious actor can inject arbitrary attributes into DOM elements via crafted React constructs. The vulnerable React version cannot be upgraded independently of nbclassic; a fix requires a new nbclassic upstream release that bundles react >=16.4.2. The classic notebook UI is only accessible to authenticated users with existing notebook access. Investigation is ongoing to assess exposure and to monitor for an upstream nbclassic fix.

react 16.0.0 is bundled as a static JS asset inside nbclassic 1.3.3, the latest release of the classic Jupyter Notebook UI extension shipped by zero-to-jupyterhub-k8s 4.4.1. CVE-2018-6341 describes a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in React prior to 16.4.2 where a malicious actor can inject arbitrary attributes into DOM elements via crafted React constructs. The vulnerable React version cannot be upgraded independently of nbclassic; a fix requires a new nbclassic upstream release that bundles react >=16.4.2. The classic notebook UI is only accessible to authenticated users with existing notebook access. Investigation is ongoing to assess exposure and to monitor for an upstream nbclassic fix.

react 16.0.0 is bundled inside nbclassic's static client-side assets at /opt/conda/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nbclassic/static/components/react/. nbclassic is the legacy Jupyter Notebook compatibility shim; the default UI shipped by this image is JupyterLab 4.x which uses its own (newer) react and does not load nbclassic's bundled copy. The renderToStaticMarkup XSS path runs in the user's browser only if the user opts into the classic /tree UI, and only with notebook content the user themselves authored or chose to open.
